git-graph.command.endAllWorkspaceCodeRev: End All Code Reviews in Workspace
git-graph.command.endSpecificWorkspaceCo: End a specific Code Review in Workspace...
git-graph.command.resumeWorkspaceCodeRev: Resume a specific Code Review in Workspace...
setting.keyboardShortcut.scrollToStash.d: Keyboard shortcut to scroll the view to the first/next stash. Hold Shift to scroll to the last/previous stash.
setting.markdown.description: Parse and render common inline Markdown (bold, italic, bold-italic, inline code) in commit messages and tag details.
setting.maxDepthOfRepoSearch.description: The maximum depth to search subfolders when discovering repositories in the workspace. Note: Submodules are not automatically detected when searching subfolders, but can be added manually using the Command Palette via 'Git Graph: Add Git Repository'.
setting.uiLanguage.description: Git Graph UI language: follow VS Code automatically (auto), English (en), Simplified Chinese (zh-CN). This primarily affects the extension's Webview; VS Code Settings page text follows VS Code's localization.
setting.commitDetailsView.autoCenter.des: Automatically center the Commit Details View when it is opened.
setting.commitDetailsView.fileTree.compa: Render the File Tree in the Commit Details View in a compacted form, such that folders with a single child folder are compressed into a single combined folder element.
Display files in a tree structure.
Display files in a list (useful for repositories with deep folder structures).
Sets the default type of File View used in the Commit Details View. This can be overridden per repository using the controls on the right side of the Commit Details View.
Show the Commit Details View inline with the graph & commits.
Show the Commit Details View docked to the bottom of the Git Graph View.
setting.commitDetailsView.location.descr: Specifies where the Commit Details View is rendered in the Git Graph View.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.0: Open new tabs in the current editor group.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.1: Open new tabs to the right of the current editor group.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.2: Open new tabs in Editor Group 1.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.3: Open new tabs in Editor Group 2.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.4: Open new tabs in Editor Group 3.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.5: Open new tabs in Editor Group 4.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.6: Open new tabs in Editor Group 5.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.7: Open new tabs in Editor Group 6.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.8: Open new tabs in Editor Group 7.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.9: Open new tabs in Editor Group 8.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.enum.10: Open new tabs in Editor Group 9.
setting.openNewTabEditorGroup.descriptio: Specifies where Git Graph opens new tabs when performing actions (e.g. View Diff, Open File, View File at this Revision).
setting.openToTheRepoOfTheActiveTextEdit: Open the Git Graph View to the repository containing the currently active text editor document.
setting.referenceLabels.alignment.enum.0: Show branch & tag labels on the left of the commit message (in the Description column).
setting.referenceLabels.alignment.enum.1: Show branch labels on the left of the commit message (in the Description column), and tag labels on the right of the commit message.
setting.referenceLabels.alignment.enum.2: Align branch labels to the graph (in the Graph column), and show tag labels on the right of the commit message (in the Description column).
setting.referenceLabels.alignment.descri: Specifies how the branch & tag reference labels are aligned for each commit.
setting.viewLocation.description: Where to show the Git Graph View when invoked: in an editor tab (editor), or in the bottom panel (panel).
